post.caption:
Topologically you are a donut. The gut is a tube passing through you, and its contents are still outside your body until they cross the wall. Nine metres, about a day end to end. Saliva enzymes start on starch before you swallow, the stomach runs acid strong enough to dissolve metal, and almost all absorption happens in the small intestine, whose folded and refolded surface would cover a tennis court. The large intestine reclaims the water.
